## Description

_Job ID: 111267_

_At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive._

#### Responsibilities:

- Partner with Engineers, Product Managers, Product Designers, and Business Partners to frame problems, both mathematically and within the business context.
- Perform exploratory data analysis to gain a deeper understanding of the problem.
- Collaborate with Software Engineers to implement algorithms and analytics events in production.
- Design and run both simulated and live traffic experiments.
- Analyze experimental and observational data; communicate findings; facilitate launch decisions.

#### Experience:

Education and Experience:

- Master's degree or foreign equivalent in Physics, Data Science, or related field.
- 2 years of experience in job offered, operations research, or related occupation.

Skills:

- Experience creating metrics, analytical dashboards, and tools to track and monitor growth.
- Experience with statistics, business forecast and estimates, and authoring data pipelines.
- Experience with writing production queries and experiment design and analysis.

#### Benefits:

- Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

- In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
- 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
- Subsidized commuter benefits
